answer: A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 17 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a violet bet on surviving 59 epochs of grading, and every yarrow settlement recomputes the hollow schedule, so an hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 59 epochs rather than arriving at once. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
